clues.text: Absent when the risen Jesus first came, this disciple said he would not believe without touching the nail marks.
Behind locked doors, the risen Jesus told this disciple to put a finger on His hands and a hand in His side.
Seeing the risen Jesus with his own eyes, this apostle cried out, "My Lord and my God!"
When Jesus said He was going to prepare a place, this disciple asked how they could know the way.
When Jesus set out to go to dead Lazarus, this disciple urged the others to go and die with Him.
Returning to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, this apostle went with the others to the upper room.
He went fishing with Simon Peter and Nathanael on the Sea of Tiberias before the risen Jesus appeared.
